description: This file defines the OrdersAdapter class for a Kotlin Android app, implementing a RecyclerView Adapter to display a list of orders with various actions and status indicators.

classes.name: OrdersAdapter
classes.description: A PagingDataAdapter subclass managing display of orders with action callbacks based on order status.

classes.name: OrdersAdapter.OrderViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView ViewHolder nested class that binds Order data to the item view and manages button visibility and actions.

methods.name: OrdersAdapter.constructor
methods.description: Initializes the adapter with callbacks for different order actions.

methods.name: OrderViewHolder.bind
methods.description: Binds an Order object to the view, updating UI elements like status, buttons, and labels.

methods.name: OrdersAdapter.onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and inflates a new OrderViewHolder with item binding.

methods.name: OrdersAdapter.onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the view holder at a particular position, with an animation effect.
